body.message:
Hi, my name is Ahmad from WAY Real Estate, nice to meet you and thanks for getting back to me

My client is looking for a 1 bedroom in City Walk for 3 months from early October and is ready to pay the full amount upfront in one payment. The request is urgent, so I need a quick answer on these points:

Is the unit available from early October for 3 months?
What is the total for 3 months including VAT, tourism tax and cleaning?
Can you fix this price for all 3 months, yes or no?
Any discount for full payment upfront?
What is your commission and do you share it 50/50 with us, yes or no?
My client is making his decision today, so a quick reply would really help. Looking forward to working together
